verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, and such a product could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API reference or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. The MCP material covers Shortwave connecting to other apps' MCP servers as a client, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
